test.create_query: CREATE TABLE perf_documents ( document_id UInt32, sorted_feature_ids Array(UInt32), feature_id UInt32 ) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO perf_documents SELECT number, arrayMap(x -> toUInt32(number + x * 17), range(8192)), toUInt32(number + (8191 - (number % 1024)) * 17) FROM numbers(1024)
test.query: SELECT sum(indexOfAssumeSorted(sorted_feature_ids, feature_id)) FROM perf_documents FORMAT Null
